body:
Addressed: Added the requested before and after viewport-bar screenshots to the PR body. Both images show Move and Pan.

The images use the application drawing code. I checked both images. They are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `1a1b33620794cd34cb7283efa0867a7f98cf09e4`.

Evidence:
- The external screenshot-link check fails with the original body. It passes with the published body. Both hosted PNGs match the inspected captures.
- `move_glyph_shows_a_part_body_while_pan_shows_only_arrows` fails with the original viewport bar. It passes after the PR source is restored.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes all nine steps. The UI unit suite passes 1161 tests, with seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

The PR head remains `47626dccdbcf330a192e26ebe5b7ebcbaee2322f`. The plain push reports that it is up to date. This finding required a body update only. No screenshot, helper, log, or evidence file was committed to the PR branch.

Please re-review this head and the updated body.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 47626dccdbcf330a192e26ebe5b7ebcbaee2322f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review replaces the earlier finding on this head. The later `Addressed:` comment permits this review of the same head.

The earlier screenshot finding is met. The body now links before and after images from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. I downloaded and inspected both images. Each shows Move beside Pan. The new Move glyph shows a part with three handles. Pan keeps its four arrows. No screenshot or review evidence is in the PR diff.

The cache guard releases the facet reference when neither handle mode can use the selected part. It keeps the shared cache for Rotate. The new glyph module has a provenance line. The decision file covers the deferred items permitted by #2508.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `9d6b57c0983afadabc452cd3ede452bb39cea577`:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=6`, from `crates/ui` | 1171 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| All six cache tests and the Move glyph test | Passed in the unit suite |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check HEAD` | Passed |

The prior intermittent `setup_mount_pages` failure did not occur in this run. The build and tests used the worktree's own target directory, with the Rust compiler wrapper disabled.

This PR changes display cache ownership and glyph drawing. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. I did not repeat the earlier mutation runs in this review. The earlier review records three red mutation results on this unchanged head.

Requested changes: none. The earlier note about fixed glyph dimensions remains non-blocking. No release gate, pixel snapshot tests, Windows build, or wasm build ran.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
